mutationRules: Subscription mutations use expectedVersion optimistic concurrency.
Entitlement mutations are idempotent and derive from trusted subscription/payment decisions; cancellation/expiry revokes all active grants belonging to the transitioning subscription.
Payment providers cannot write these tables directly.
Membership cannot write ledger balance or transaction truth.
Cancellation/expiry must converge entitlement access state.
Subscription writes use atomic WHERE subscription_id = ? AND version = expectedVersion; successful transition increments version by one.
Payment/Subscription mutating operations that require Idempotency-Key persist the Membership-scoped replay record in the same D1-01 transaction as the authoritative access-state mutation.

membership_mutation_idempotency.purpose: Per-membership-mutation replay protection kept in D1-01 so the idempotency record and Subscription/Entitlement mutation share one transaction.
rules: Same owner + operation + key + same request_hash replays the committed response without repeating the mutation.
Same owner + operation + key + different request_hash is rejected with IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE_CONFLICT.
Concurrent same-key requests converge by the unique key boundary; a losing request must not apply a second business mutation.
The idempotency record is scoped to Membership operations and is not a generic D1-03 platform idempotency authority.

membership_txn_guard.purpose: Fail-closed same-transaction guard proving the expected-version Subscription update changed exactly one row before the idempotency record can commit.
